notes: •  Camera Settings now makes it plain when a change has been saved. After Apply, a green banner across the bottom of the window says SAVED, how many settings, on which camera, and the time - and each setting the camera took is marked green with a check mark and "(saved)". A change that works only until the camera restarts gets an amber banner (CHANGED, NOT STORED); a problem gets a red one. While you are still editing, changed settings are yellow and marked "(not sent yet)", and the bottom line counts the changes waiting for Apply.
